title: The Claw
html:
The Claw
Client type:  2H Sword
Class palette:  Fighter
Quality:  Mythic (rainbow)

The Claw is a named mythic item from the client file 2HSwordMythicPAL.gc (2HSwordMythic100).

This is the base name. Rolled mythics can also append a suffix from Mythic Suffixes. Those endings change the last part of the name and add the bonus listed on that page. This page does not invent extra roll combinations.

The client marks this entry as wishing-well only. The template sets SoulBound = true. That which The Claw grabs is unknown even unto itself.

This mythic entry does not declare enhancement Mod blocks of its own. It only sets the name and the flags above.
